answer: Bind each agent seat to a commissioned notary public. The state issues one commission per person after a background check, and each notary must post a surety bond and keep a sealed journal. A bond and commission cost about $200 per seat, so 5,000 sybil seats would cost $1M plus 5,000 background checks that share no names. A seat signs its key with its notary seal, so a farm of fakes cannot hide behind a cipher: every stamp traces back up a river of records to one person, not an island of bots.
